coverage.note: All 1,938 entities are treated in parallel. The 1,741 figure is the conventional 'municipality' count (市町村 + 特別区); the 197 are 政令指定都市の行政区 which carry their own JIS codes.

schedule.freshness_target_note: We aim to refresh every record within 30 days. This is the freshness target, not a load mitigation.

implementation.budget: time-boxed: the daily run scrapes stale-first municipalities until a wall-clock budget is spent, then stops launching new work so the R-3 refresh, state commit, and Hugging Face sync complete inside the job timeout

rate_limit.steady_state: 5 seconds minimum between requests to the same domain
rate_limit.initial_bootstrap: 2 seconds minimum, used only for the first build to complete in hours

data_freshness_promise: No record left stale beyond 30 days under steady-state operation.

stability_contract.stable_ids: Entity identifiers are invariant across snapshots. Wikidata-backed entities use their QID; scraped spots use a URL-derived id (sha256 of the source URL), so a re-scrape of unchanged content keeps the same id. Consumers may treat ids as durable keys across snapshots.
stability_contract.honest_nulls: Absent data is null, never an inferred or estimated value presented as measured. A null means 'not stated by an official source' — treat it as unknown, not as a fact.
stability_contract.additive_fields: Field changes are additive and backward-compatible. New fields may appear; existing field meanings do not change without a schema_version bump.
stability_contract.pinning: For reproducibility, pin to a Hugging Face dataset commit revision; that revision is the immutable version of the snapshot you verified against.
